verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is itself an agent gateway, so this axis would normally be na, but its first-party CLI docs show it can run as an MCP server via the `openclaw mcp serve` subcommand. A probe confirms the official MCP server page exists at docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp, so external agents have an official MCP endpoint to connect to. Missing for 10: details on which tools/resources the server exposes, transport/auth and client-connection setup, and independent or hands-on confirmation that server mode works.
